{{Quote|Build a Neimoidian Throne within the flags.|Nute Gunray, to OOM-9|audio=ThroneBuild.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
A '''Neimoidan Throne''' was a type of building created by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], symbolizing the pinnacle of its culture. They were built using large quanitities of [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]], [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]], and [[Ore/Legends|ore]] and consisted of a square base with four curved spikes on each corner. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the Trade Federation built two Neimoidian Thrones on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during their [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. One was built in the [[Palace Plaza/Legends|Palace Plaza]] in front of [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]] during the [[Capture of Theed/Legends|fall]] of that [[Theed/Legends|capital city]], while the other was built in the ruins of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Spinnaker/Legends|Spinnaker]], but it was [[Liberation of Spinnaker|destroyed]] by the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Here are the resources you will need to build my throne.|Nute Gunray, to OOM-9|audio=ThroneResources.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
A Neimoidian Throne was a large [[monument]] associated with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], whose leadership consisted of members of the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. They were constructed using large quantities of [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]], [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]], and [[Ore/Legends|ore]].<ref name="GB" /> A Neimoidian Throne represented the pinnacle of the Trade Federation's art, culture, and technology.<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> The square-shaped structure had [[Color/Legends|brown]] plating that rose up on each side and met at the structure's center, and each side had a strip of black plating in the center. The corners of the throne had tall pointed spikes that rose above the base structure and curved inward. Two smaller tusk-like decorations were installed next to the center of the throne.<ref name="GB" />

==History==
{{Quote|Wesa will teach those machineeks a good lesson! Destroyen their bombad temple and maxibig throne!|Boss Rugor Nass|audio=TeachMachineeksLesson.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
Two Neimoidian Thrones were constructed on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] by the Trade Federation during their [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. During the [[Capture of Theed/Legends|Fall of Theed]], in which the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] captured Naboo's [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] ordered the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]] to construct a Neimoidian Throne next to [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]].<ref name="GB" /> Gunray intended to prove the Trade Federation's superiority and demoralize the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo people]] through the construction of the throne.<ref name="Prima" />

[[File:Spinnaker_monument.png|thumb|left|290px|The Neimoidian Throne in Spinnaker]]
After OOM-9's forces destroyed a [[Theed signal jammer|signal jammer]], Gunray dispatched six [[OX9]] [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droids]] to Theed so that they could construct the throne. Once the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] had captured the grounds surrounding Theed Palace, Gunray sent the necessary resources to the droids so that they could construct the throne, warning them not to waste the resources on anything else. The labor droids built the throne in the [[Palace Plaza/Legends|Palace Plaza]] while OOM-9's [[Army/Legends|army]] defended the site from the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]. Once the building was complete, Gunray congratulated OOM-9 on his successful capture of Theed.<ref name="GB" />

Another Neimoidian Throne was built in the ruins of the city [[Spinnaker/Legends|Spinnaker]], which the Trade Federation had [[Invasion of Spinnaker|captured]] and occupied prior to the Fall of Theed. The throne was protected by three heavy [[Turret/Legends|turrets]], a heavy [[Anti-aircraft gun|anti-air turret]], and a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]]. When the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] sought to liberate [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] and Naboo [[Prison/Legends|prisoners]] from [[Camp 14]] near Spinnaker, its leader, [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]], chose to [[Liberation of Spinnaker|attack]] the occupied city and destroy the Neimoidian Throne.<ref name="GB" /> The Droid Army at the city had significant forces assigned to protect the throne,<ref name="Prima" /> but they were overrun by the Gungans, who destroyed the throne and built a [[Gungan Temple]] in its place.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Paste the Neimoidian Throne and take back Theed for Naboo!|Captain Tarpals in the non-canon Gungan scenario|audio=TarpalsPastePalace.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Neimoidian_Throne.jpg|thumb|right|310px|The Neimoidian Throne in the non-canon Gungan level]]
Neimoidian Thrones were introduced in [[Prima Games]]' [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]] by [[Steven L. Kent]],<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> released on [[November 7]], [[2001]],<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref> for the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', which was released on [[November 11]] that year.<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> The buildings serve as the Trade Federation's Monument, a type of building that, in some versions of the standard game mode, can be constructed to grant the player victory if it is not destroyed for two hundred in-game [[Standard day/Legends|days]]. Monuments typically cost 3000 units each of carbon, nova crystals, and ore, but this can be reduced to 2850 units each by upgrades at [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] unique to the Trade Federation civilization. These upgrades are titled "Neimoidian Endorsement" and "Market Insider Trading," and they reduce the cost of buildings by 5% and 10%, respectively.<ref name="GB" />

Neimoidian Thrones play roles in multiple levels in the campaigns of ''Galactic Battlegrounds''. The first one is "Capturing the Crown," the fourth level of the Trade Federation campaign. In it, the player is instructed to build a Monument after taking control of the Theed Royal Palace grounds to achieve victory. Nute Gunray provides the player with exactly 2850 units of carbon, nova crystals, and ore to build the Neimoidian Throne, and the level is automatically lost if the player chooses to construct any buildings other than the throne or if the building is destroyed by the Naboo before its completion.<ref name="GB" /> The Prima guide recommends that the player destroy the Naboo's military buildings as their army proceeds through Theed in order to lessen the extent of the attacks on the Monument later on.<ref name="Prima" />

[[File:Neimoidian_throne_destroyed.png|thumb|left|230px|The Gungans destroy the Theed Neimoidian throne in a non-canon level.]]
The fifth level of the Gungan campaign, "The Chains Are Broken," features another Neimoidian Throne, which the player is required to destroy to complete the level. They are then required to build their own Monument on top of the site of the Neimoidian Throne. The Neimoidian Throne in Theed reappears in "The Battle for Theed," the seventh and final level of the Gungan campaign. The level is [[Canon|non-canon]] within the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity and portrays what could have happened if the Gungan Grand Army had [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|defeated]] the Trade Federation Droid Army at the [[Great Grass Plains/Legends|Great Grass Plains]],<ref name="GB" /> rather than being saved by the intervention of the character [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] as portrayed in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> The player completes the level by taking their army through Theed and destroying the Neimoidian Throne.<ref name="GB" /> The strategy guide recommends doing so through the use<ref name="Prima" /> of [[cerrabore]]s, the Gungan equivalent of [[Energy pummel/Legends|pummels]]. The throne itself is defended by one medium turret and three anti-air turrets.<ref name="GB" />
